edition.notes: Labeled regional variant. North Indian ‘Jai Kali Mata’ remains kali-aarti. Line-order and refrain vary by pith; this is a short Bengal-mood household aarti, not a critical folk edition.

description.hi: बंगाल पीठ की आरती शैली — जय काली महाकाली।
description.en: Bengal pith aarti style — Jai Kali Mahakali.
